name: shopify-storefront-qa
description: QA harnesses for the Alpkit Shopify storefront - live-site bike-builder basket sweep via Browserbase
summary: Runs automated checks on the live Alpkit Shopify storefront to make sure every Sonder bike can be added to the shopping basket without issues. This helps the store team catch problems that customers might face when selecting bike options and adding them to their cart, ensuring the buying process works smoothly. It handles real page interactions and deals with common hiccups like out-of-stock options and geo-based prompts.
